Run complete TSENAT analysis pipeline

Source: R/orchestration.R
tsenat.Rd

Coordinates the full TSENAT workflow: diversity -> jackknife -> LM interactions -> divergence -> gene interactions -> visualizations.

tsenat(
  se,
  config = NULL,
  methods = NULL,
  q_values = NULL,
  generate_plots = TRUE,
  verbose = TRUE,
  parallel = FALSE,
  ...
)

Arguments

se

SummarizedExperiment containing expression counts.

config

list or TSENATConfig. Configuration from tsenat_config. If NULL, uses defaults.

methods

character. Specific methods to run (overrides config).

q_values

numeric. Specific q-values (overrides config).

generate_plots

logical. Create visualizations. Default: TRUE.

verbose

logical. Print progress messages. Default: TRUE.

parallel

logical. Run independent q-values in parallel. Default: FALSE.

...

Additional arguments passed to individual wrapper functions.

Value

TSENATAnalysis object containing complete analysis results, plots, and metadata.

Details

Pipeline execution order (enforced):

  1. calculate_diversity_s4() - Tsallis entropy per q-value

  2. jackknife_entropy_outliers_s4() - Confidence intervals

  3. jackknife_isoform_switching_s4() - Transcript switching (optional)

  4. calculate_lm_interaction_s4() - Statistical tests

  5. calculate_difference_s4() - Pairwise group differences (optional)

  6. calculate_divergence_s4() - Pairwise divergence metrics

  7. effect_sizes_divergence_s4() - Effect sizes (optional)

  8. rank_test_q_condition_s4() - Q-dependent interactions

  9. test_rankbased_assumptions_s4() - Assumption validation (optional)

  10. compute_method_concordance_s4() - Method comparison (optional)

  11. Plot generation (if enabled)

Examples

library(SummarizedExperiment)
se <- SummarizedExperiment(
  assays = list(counts = matrix(rpois(100, 10), nrow = 10, ncol = 10,
                                 dimnames = list(sprintf('G%d', 1:10), NULL))),
  colData = data.frame(
    condition = rep(c('A', 'B'), 5),
    sample_id = rep(c('S1', 'S2'), 5)
  )
)
cfg <- tsenat_config(q_values = c(0.5, 1.0), generate_plots = FALSE)
analysis <- tsenat(se, config = cfg)
#> TSENAT Pipeline
